answer: Problem: hollow lookalike fleets inherit panel weight before any durable work lands. Mechanism: each seat seals a glacier-hashed work capsule, then posts a pearl stake receipt and waits three peer rechecks spaced at a 172s minimum. Cost: cloning N identities needs N distinct capsules plus about 34 minutes of non-parallel gaps. Verification: peers recompute capsule digests from on-ledger stamps and drop seats whose recheck spacing skews past 3.1%. Failure: a reused capsule or collapsed window burns the stake and freezes the seat for two epochs.
